task: 2.3 Make tenant host resolution fail closed
schema_note: No schema or backend API surface change. Production resolver code (OfferingDirectoryService.resolved_institution_id, InstitutionContextService.is_registered_shared_portal_host, catalog cache scope signature) already implemented the fail-closed behavior; task 2.3 adds the Required_Evidence tests and corrects one stale contradicting test.

prevent_explicit_filter_overriding_trust.mechanism: OfferingDirectoryService.resolved_institution_id returns the resolved host tenant whenever portal_context.institution is set; the ?institution= selector is never consulted in that branch.

explicit_selection_only_on_registered_ne.mechanism: Explicit selector honored iff (no trusted host context) AND (endpoint in OfferingDirectoryService.EXPLICIT_INSTITUTION_SELECTION_ENDPOINTS = {canonical_programs, assignment_preview}) AND (InstitutionContextService.is_registered_shared_portal_host(host) via SHARED_PORTAL_HOSTS allowlist).

partition_caches_by_canonical_institutio.mechanism: catalog cache scope signature (_catalog_scope_signature) keys on the resolved host tenant (inst:<id>) or the honored shared-portal selection; a conflicting ?institution= on a trusted host never repartitions; non-selector endpoints stay neutral.

partition_background_task_context_by_can.mechanism: Background tasks carry the canonical institution id on the record they process (e.g. verify_institution_domain_task uses domain.institution_id) and have no host/query to override it; any per-institution cache/context is keyed by catalog_institution_scope(institution_id), so distinct institutions never share a partition and never cross-serve.

stale_test_corrected.before: test_resolved_institution_id_prefers_explicit_then_context (asserted pre-TEN-10 'explicit selector wins over resolved host'; failed against the fail-closed resolver)
stale_test_corrected.after: test_resolved_institution_id_trusted_host_wins_and_fails_closed (asserts trusted host wins; explicit only on allow-listed endpoint + registered shared-portal host)

environment_gating: none — all required tests run without skips or credential gating (V2 CI profile rule R1.4)
